messages:
deploybot: Deploy complete: release v2.14.3-rc3 -> prod-usw2. 12 instances healthy, canary at 5%. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/example :rocket:
eva_sre: quick sanity check — canaries look fine from infra side but synthetic probes are starting to report an anomaly in eu region :eyes:
sam_qa: seeing failures on the "short-prompt-scanline" probe (it returns truncated tokens for ~12% of requests). repro script attached: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/smoke -d '{"prompt":"short"}'``` ben_eng: hm, only on eu? which model variant is routed there? morgan_release: eu is on model-quant-v2 (new quant profile) for the canary. prod-usw2 is unaffected so far.sam_qa: correct — usw2 probe p95 stable. eu probe p95 spiked and we see 5xx and malformed payloads in the probe logs: ```2026-03-21T14:03:12Z ERROR tokenizer: mismatch len 0 != expected 3```eva_sre: I want to see if it's probe-side (tokenizer mismatch in harness) or model output. Can someone run the same probe against the previous model variant (model-quant-v1) in eu? ben_eng: running quick A/B: hitting model-quant-v1 endpoint now... result: probe returned normal tokens, 0% malformed.sam_qa: so new quant profile likely introduced regression in short prompts. impact: only the synthetic probe (coverage of short prompts) and small fraction of real traffic (we have feature flagged short-form endpoint)ben_eng: suggested immediate mitigation: route short-prompt traffic to model-quant-v1 while keeping other traffic on v2. That would be a partial rollback (traffic-split), not full service rollback.morgan_release: agree. prefer traffic-split + pin short prompt route to v1 for now, then hotfix quant profile in next patch. Avoid full rollback unless errors escalate to user-facing 500s.eva_sre: action items: 1) Sam to increase synthetic sampling for eu short-prompt probe to 1k samples over next 10 minutes and post results. 2) Ben to implement routing rule (short_prompt -> model-quant-v1) and deploy with canary. 3) Morgan to notify CS if user-facing errors observed. 4) If probe failure > 20% across regions, escalate to full rollback. sam_qa: increasing samples now. will post summary in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: ben_eng: creating routing change, pushing canary at 6% then 20% if green. will ping when done. ```PATCH /routing
{ "route": "short_prompt", "target": "model-quant-v1", "weight": 6 }```morgan_release: logging this as a post-deploy note in the release log. tagging for follow-up in next changelist. eva_sre: also updating the smoke runbook: add a step to rerun tokenizer-localization check when swapping quant profiles. small doc blurb: "If tokenizer mismatch observed on short prompts after quant change, route short_prompt to previous variant and file quant hotfix."sam_qa: sampled 1000 eu short prompts: malformed count 121 (12.1%) — still elevated. we'll let routing change stabilize and re-run in 10m.ben_eng: routing change is live at 6% canary. watch logs and metric: probe_malformed_count{region="eu"}.morgan_release: good. if canary stabilizes, increase to 20% and then 100% for short_prompt only. no full rollback now. assign follow-up ticket: REL-3129 (quant hotfix + regression test).eva_sre: leaving this open for 30m monitoring. if malformed > 20% after routing, immediate pin and rollback plan. thx all :thumbsup:
